RumorFact.Text: -These fluctuations may be related to the glowing asteroid.

ExploreFact.Text: -Half way through the loop, I felt the effects of the Ash-Twin Project - I was pulled into the future!
-The future is very different, most notably: "Kanaloa's Rest" has frozen over and "Silvanus' Peak" is overgrown and has a very large Bramble Node on the surface.
-After the star exploded, I was sent all the back to the past. it seems I'm going to spend half of each loop in the past, and he other half in the future!
-I found recordings from future Chronolapods, some of them were from Brevipes but I spoke to him in the past, how is that possible?
